title: Improve Context Window Management and Large File Handling

labels.name: Bot Responded
labels.description: Issue has received an automated response

body:
## Problem

Cline currently has several critical limitations when handling large files and managing context windows that lead to unrecoverable errors and excessive token usage:

**File Reading Limitations:**
- Files over 300KB are blocked from being read, even when using models with large context windows (1M+ tokens)
- When Cline accidentally reads large files, it triggers 'prompt too long' errors with no recovery option
- Users must start entirely new tasks when hitting token limits, losing all progress

**Context Management Issues:**
- Entire file contents are sent to the API instead of using chunked/streaming approaches
- Excessive token usage (millions of tokens for simple tasks) making paid models unaffordable
- Poor context window management algorithm that doesn't handle large terminal output effectively
- No recovery mechanism when API requests exceed token limits

**User Impact:**
- Tasks become unrecoverable when hitting token limits - users can only 'Retry' or 'Start New Task'
- Massive token costs making Cline impractical with paid models
- Inability to work with legitimate large files even on high-context models
- Loss of work progress when context overload occurs

## Solution

Implement comprehensive context window management improvements:

1. **Dynamic File Size Limits**: Remove the hardcoded 300KB limit and make it configurable based on the selected model's context window
2. **Chunked File Reading**: Implement streaming/chunked reading for large files instead of loading entire contents
3. **Smart Context Truncation**: Improve the context management algorithm to intelligently truncate old messages while preserving essential context
4. **Recovery Mechanisms**: Allow users to modify prompts and continue tasks when hitting token limits instead of forcing task restart
5. **Token Usage Optimization**: Reduce redundant context sending and implement better context compression
6. **User Controls**: Add settings for maximum file size, context management strategy, and token usage warnings

## Related Issues

- Closes #1275 - When Cline 'accidentally' reads a very large file, your task is done
- Closes #2309 - Error reading file: File is too large to read into context
- Closes #3433 - YOU SHOULDN'T try to pass the whole super-long context to API at one time
- Closes #2117 - Change read_file reading into streaming mode
- Closes #421 - API Request failed, cannot reprompt AI, can only retry
- Closes #2110 - Cline using millions of tokens
- Closes #827 - Fix context window management algorithm to handle large terminal output or file reads
